name: contextforge-tests
description: Integration tests: API auth/RBAC/CRUD against in-memory Postgres, and end-to-end MCP tool calls.

scripts.//: Both suites import a sibling project's src, and an import resolves its deps from that project's own node_modules - so every project reached into must be installed first. api.test.mjs reaches into ../address-api; omitting it fails a clean clone with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for jsonwebtoken.
scripts.//2: cd, not --prefix. 'npm --prefix ../x install' run from a directory that has its own package.json installs THIS package into ../x - which silently added 'contextforge-tests' as a dependency of every sibling it touched.
scripts.pretest: cd ../address-api && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../mcp-server && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../mcp-client/server && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
